name: Italy: Part II package and CTIS upload check
applies_to: the Italy package as a whole (plan-level checklist step)

items.check: K1 recruitment and informed-consent procedure present, on EudraLex template v2.0, with a section for every consent pathway in the plan.
K2 recruitment material present for every recruitment tool, or a statement that none is used.
One main L1 information and consent form per population and consent pathway.
Separate Italian privacy information and data-processing consent present for every signer route, on the CCNCE model of 13 August 2026.

Population-specific L1 documents present for every population set whose trigger is true (healthy volunteers, minors with parent form and 6–11 and 12–17 documents, limited capacity, emergency, impartial witness, pregnancy follow-up).
S1 biological-samples compliance information and the separate Italian participant sample consent where applicable.
For every site: M1 PI CV (EU template), M2 declaration of interests (CCNCE model v4), N1 site suitability (EU template, signed by the institution).
O1 insurance certificate under the Ministerial Decree of 14 July 2009, in Italian, signed by the insurer, with policy terms when needed.
P1 reimbursement and allowance statement on the CCNCE national model, and P2 agreement material on the national clinical-trial agreement v3 for every site.
R1 data-protection compliance statement present in addition to the participant privacy notice.
Operational patient-facing materials placed according to purpose (Part I with the protocol when they define endpoint collection; otherwise in the designated Part II category only where required).
Every site, investigator and population in CTIS has its corresponding document.

CCNCE general-practitioner or paediatrician letter (7 January 2026) prepared when communication with the participant's doctor is relevant; recommended for the participant, not a mandatory CTIS or ethics-review upload.
The CCNCE page checked immediately before filing for newer models (the May 2024 Article 7 evaluation guide is marked under revision).
Every participant- or representative-facing document is in Italian.
Non-participant documents are in Italian or English; the insurance certificate is in Italian.
Participant documents are blank: no participant, representative, parent, investigator or witness signature at submission.

N1 signed by the institution's legal representative or authorised delegate (PAdES or equivalent); O1 signed by the insurer; no other signature added where CTIS filing replaces the sponsor signature (K1, P1, R1, S1, M1, M2).
Qualified language support, translated material and cultural mediation described for planned non-Italian-speaking enrolment.
Protocol number, EU trial number, sponsor, study title, version, date and language match across the package.
Reimbursement amounts and conditions identical in P1, the site agreement material and every participant document.
Insurer, policy, cover and claim route identical in O1 and every participant document.
Sample types, storage, transfers and retention identical in S1, the protocol, the participant documents and the sample consent.
Data flows, recipients, transfers and retention identical in R1, the privacy notice, the participant documents and the protocol.
Consent pathways in K1 match the L1 documents in the package.
Documents adapted from the reference package contain all Italian national additions and no leftovers from the reference country.
items.applies_when: Italy is not the reference package

items.check: Correct B–S section prefix and CTIS category for each document (privacy notice and R1 under personal data protection; sample consent with the subject information).
Unique, self-explanatory title of at most 100 characters: <section code>_<document type>_<subtype>_<country>_<language>_<special attribute>, with only the fields that distinguish the document.
Version and date entered in CTIS metadata, not in the CTIS title; the uploaded filename, if it carries version and date, matches the visible document version.
Personal names only where disclosure permits (principal investigator in M1/M2).
Clean, redacted or public and split-file variants clearly distinguished; no tracked-change versions uploaded as clean.
Uploaded filename base contains none of ( ) / , . ; | [ ] (the period before the extension is fine).
Article 11 workaround: every mandatory Part II placeholder holds the official placeholder PDF titled Part_II_placeholder_document_Article_11_workaround.
items.applies_when: Italy receives Part I only under Article 11

items.check: For each document, publication status checked against the current Annex I publication tables (revised rules applicable from 18 June 2024; ACT EU guidance v2.2, 30 April 2026).
Publishable documents: a public version with personal data and qualifying CCI redacted, plus the complete version for assessment where required.
No personal data or CCI in structured CTIS fields.
No drafting instruction remains in any document (see content/conventions/template-instructions.md); no tracked changes, comments, hidden text or completed participant data.
Every document approved by the owner in TrialAgents, or the user has explicitly chosen to export unapproved versions.
Patient-facing QC checklist run on every participant document before filing.
